groups.definition: Unsettled law on ownership of AI-generated or AI-embedded IP may cause loss of the company's IP rights.

Claims by third parties, including non-practicing entities and AI-related copyright holders, that the company infringes their IP may lead to damages, injunctions, indemnification costs or product redesign.

groups.canonical_name: Theft and misappropriation of intellectual property
groups.definition: Theft, misappropriation or counterfeiting of the company's proprietary technology by insiders, intruders or copiers may erode its competitive position.
